**Genotype Formatting**
```{bash}
#remove 10 people with missing covariate information
plink --bfile ~/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/final_qc --remove ~/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/ten_fids_remove.fam --make-bed --out ~/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/final_qc_minus_ten

plink --bfile ~/xchrom/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/final_qc --remove ~/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/ten_fids_remove.fam --make-bed --out ~/xchrom/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/final_qc_minus_ten

#apply geno 0.02 and maf 0.01 post filtering 10 individuals
plink --bfile ~/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/final_qc_minus_ten --geno 0.02 --maf 0.01 --make-bed --out ~/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/final_qc_minus_ten_filtered

plink --bfile ~/xchrom/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/final_qc_minus_ten --geno 0.02 --maf 0.01 --make-bed --out ~/xchrom/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/final_qc_minus_ten_filtered
```

**Combine autosomal and chr 23 genotype files**
```{bash}
#check sex
plink --bfile ~/xchrom/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/final_qc_minus_ten_filtered --check-sex --out ~/xchrom/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/check_sex

#update sex
plink --bfile ~/xchrom/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/final_qc_minus_ten_filtered --update-sex ~/xchrom/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/check_sex.sexcheck --make-bed --out ~/xchrom/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/sex_updated_xchr

#merge files
plink --bfile ~/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/final_qc_minus_ten_filtered --bmerge ~/xchrom/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/sex_updated_xchr --make-bed --out ~/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/merged_auto_x

#make plink2 files, adding additional check to ensure geno 0.02 and maf 0.01
plink2 --bfile ~/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/merged_auto_x --output-chr chr26 --geno 0.02 --maf 0.01 --make-pgen --out ~/ancestry_specific_folder/new_plink_files/ancestry_final
```

**Phenotype Formatting**
```{r}
#read in files
csv <- fread("~/ancestry_specific_folder/residmat_table")
#csv <- read.csv("/home/matt/2024-11-12_TOPMed_MESA_Proteomics_QC/allpops/data/allpops_average_adjusted_prot.csv")

demographic <- fread("~/ancestry_specific_folder/protein_sidno_data", header = TRUE)

#filter columns
filtered_demographic <- demographic %>%
  filter(demographic$sidno %in% (csv$sidno))

#isolate ID columns
fid_sidno_snp <- select(filtered_demographic, "FID", "sidno")
fid_sidno_snp <- unique(fid_sidno_snp)

#add sidno ids based on corresponding smp
residmat_sidno <- left_join(fid_sidno_snp, csv, by=c("sidno"))
residmat_fid <- residmat_sidno[, -c(2)]

#transpose and format
adjusted_residmat <- t(residmat_fid[, -1])
colnames(adjusted_residmat) <- residmat_fid$FID
adjusted_residmat <- as.data.table(adjusted_residmat)
adjusted_residmat$oids<- colnames(residmat_fid[, -1])
new_residmat <- adjusted_residmat %>%
  select(oids, everything())

new_residmat <- new_residmat %>%
  select(oids, sort(names(.)[-1]))

#save file
write.table(new_residmat, "~/ancestry_specific_folder/lm_table", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, sep="\t", quote=FALSE)

#read in files
levels <- fread("~/ancestry_specific_folder/lm_table")
locations <- fread("~/protein_locations/allchr_protein_location_file")

#format columns
joined <- left_join(locations, levels, by=c("OlinkID"="oids"), keep=TRUE)
joined <- joined %>% select(2:ncol(joined))
colnames(joined)[1] = "#chr"
colnames(joined)[2] = "start"
colnames(joined)[3] = "end"
colnames(joined)[4] = "gene_id"

joined$"#chr" <- gsub("^chr", "", joined$"#chr")

#convert chromosome column to integer for proper sorting
joined$"#chr" <- as.integer(joined$"#chr")

#sort by chromosome and position (start)
sorted_joined <- joined[order(joined$"#chr", joined$start, joined$end), ]

#add the "chr" prefix back
sorted_joined$"#chr" <- paste("chr", sorted_joined$"#chr", sep = "")
sorted_joined$"#chr" <- as.vector(sorted_joined$"#chr")

#save file
write.table(sorted_joined, "~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensor_lm_table.bed", col.names=TRUE, row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep="\t")

#gzip file for tensorQTL input
system("gzip -f ~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensor_lm_table.bed")
```
